```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat); library(Signac)
  library(universalmotif)
  library(TFBSTools)
  library(motifmatchr)
  library(GenomicRanges); library(GenomeInfoDb)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(data.table)

})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
DATA_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
CAND_DIR     <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "candidates")
OUT_REX_DIR  <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores", "rex")
dir.create(OUT_REX_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
fa    <- sub("\\.gz$", "", fa_gz)

# URL (Ensembl release 115)
url <- "https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-115/fasta/homo_sapiens/dna/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa.gz"

# Download if missing
if (!file.exists(fa) && !file.exists(fa_gz)) {
  message("Downloading GRCh38 primary assembly...")
  download.file(url, destfile = fa_gz, mode = "wb")
}

# Decompress if needed
if (!file.exists(fa) && file.exists(fa_gz)) {
  message("Unzipping FASTA...")
  R.utils::gunzip(fa_gz, overwrite = TRUE)
}

# Index if needed
if (!file.exists(paste0(fa, ".fai"))) {
  message("Indexing FASTA with Rsamtools...")
  Rsamtools::indexFa(fa)
}

# Open genome
genome <- FaFile(fa)
```

```{r}
## load peaks and harmonize seqnames for Ensembl FaFile
seo   <- readRDS(seurat_path)
peaks <- granges(seo[["ATAC"]])
peaks <- GenomeInfoDb::keepStandardChromosomes(peaks, pruning.mode = "coarse")
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(peaks) <- "Ensembl"
mcols(peaks)$peak_id <- rownames(seo[["ATAC"]])

## read + merge LHX Grade-A motifs, convert to PFMatrix (for out="positions")
motifs_all <- universalmotif::read_jaspar(jaspar_txt_path)
ids <- if (!is.null(names(motifs_all))) names(motifs_all) else
         vapply(motifs_all, function(m) m@name, "")
motifs_lhx <- motifs_all[grep("^LHX.+\\.A$", ids)]
stopifnot(length(motifs_lhx) > 0)

rex_um  <- universalmotif::trim_motifs(universalmotif::merge_motifs(motifs_lhx))
rex_pfm <- universalmotif::convert_motifs(rex_um, class = "TFBSTools-PFMatrix")

build_LUT_from_positions <- function(peaks, pfm, genome, pad = 16L, p_cutoff = 0.01) {
  # extend peaks and compute mid
  ext <- resize(peaks, width(peaks) + 2L * pad, fix = "center")
  mid <- start(ext) + (width(ext) - 1L) %/% 2L

  # scan positions (once) on extended peaks
  pos_list <- motifmatchr::matchMotifs(
    pfm, ext, genome = genome, out = "positions", p.cutoff = p_cutoff
  )
  pos_gr <- pos_list[[1]]

  # geometry table always exists
  lut_geom <- data.table(
    peak_id = mcols(peaks)$peak_id,
    chr     = as.character(seqnames(ext)),  
    mid     = as.integer(mid)
  )

  # if no hits at all, return zeroed scores
  if (length(pos_gr) == 0L) {
    LUT <- copy(lut_geom)[, `:=`(score_left = 0, score_right = 0)]
    return(LUT[])
  }

  # attach peak_id & mid to hits
  ov <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(pos_gr, ext, select = "first")
  pos_gr$peak_id <- mcols(peaks)$peak_id[ov]
  pos_gr$mid     <- as.integer(mid[ov])

  # hits -> table, classify side relative to mid
  pos_dt <- data.table(
    peak_id   = pos_gr$peak_id,
    motif_pos = GenomicRanges::start(pos_gr),
    score     = S4Vectors::mcols(pos_gr)$score,
    mid       = pos_gr$mid
  )
  pos_dt[, side := ifelse(motif_pos <= mid, "left", "right")]

  # aggregate per-peak: take MAX per side (switch to mean() if you prefer)
  lut_pos <- pos_dt[
    , .(
        score_left  = suppressWarnings(max(score[side == "left"],  na.rm = TRUE)),
        score_right = suppressWarnings(max(score[side == "right"], na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
    by = peak_id
  ]

  # merge geometry and fill NAs with zero (peaks with no hits on a side)
  LUT <- merge(lut_geom, lut_pos, by = "peak_id", all.x = TRUE)
  LUT[is.na(score_left),  score_left := 0]
  LUT[is.na(score_right), score_right := 0]
  LUT[]
}

LUT <- build_LUT_from_positions(peaks, rex_pfm, genome, pad = pad, p_cutoff = p_cut)

## ---- REX-style scoring per link using LUT ----
compute_arex_from_LUT <- function(cand, LUT) {
  cand <- as.data.table(cand)

  # Normalize column names 
  if ("peak" %in% names(cand) && !"peak_id" %in% names(cand)) setnames(cand, "peak", "peak_id")
  if (!"peak" %in% names(cand) && "peak_id" %in% names(cand)) cand[, peak := peak_id]
  if ("gene_chr" %in% names(cand)) cand[, gene_chr := sub("^chr", "", gene_chr)]

  # Require minimal inputs
  req <- c("peak_id", "gene_id", "gene_chr", "tss")
  miss <- setdiff(req, names(cand))
  if (length(miss)) stop("Candidates missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  # Merge full candidate table with per-peak LUT
  DT <- merge(cand, LUT, by = "peak_id", all.x = TRUE)

  # Keep valid geometry on same chromosome
  DT <- DT[gene_chr == chr & !is.na(tss) & !is.na(mid)]

  # Toward vs. away relative to TSS
  toward_is_right <- DT$tss > DT$mid
  toward <- ifelse(toward_is_right, DT$score_right, DT$score_left)
  away   <- ifelse(toward_is_right, DT$score_left,  DT$score_right)

  DT[, arex_score := (toward - away) / pmax(abs(toward), abs(away), 1e-6)]

  # Final 3-column output
  DT[, .(peak = peak_id, gene = gene_id, score = arex_score)]
}


```
```{r}
cand_files <- list.files(CAND_DIR, pattern = "^candidates_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

for (f in cand_files) {
  message("Scoring ", f)
  cand   <- fread(f)
  scored <- compute_arex_from_LUT(cand, LUT)

  out_path <- file.path(OUT_REX_DIR, paste0("scored_", basename(f)))
  fwrite(scored, out_path, sep = "\t")
  message("Wrote: ", out_path, " (", nrow(scored), " rows)")
}
```
